s3.ptxt: Insert SST (tool) into the stator shaft engagement area.
Insert SST (stopper) from the sleeve of the torque converter and engage it with the notch of the stator thrust washer.
Stand the torque converter assembly upright and turn SST (tool).

specitem.ptxt: It rotates freely when turned clockwise and locks when turned counterclockwise.

s3.ptxt: If the inspection results of the torque converter assembly correspond to the criteria, replace the torque converter assembly.

specitem.ptxt: A metallic noise is heard from the torque converter during a stall test or in neutral.
The 1-way clutch is free or locked in both directions.
Fine particles in the fluid exceed the limit sample (refer to the limit sample).

item.ptxt: The limit sample of fine particles in the fluid is approximately 25mL of fluid (1 35mm film cases' worth) drained into a petri dish from a removed torque converter.
For the limit sample of fine particles in the fluid, refer to [the precautions packed with the rebuilt A/T] or [A/T Rebuilt Parts Handling Manual (Part No. 63264)] issued in 1/1998.

s3.ptxt: If the fluid has an abnormal odor or is discolored, thoroughly stir the fluid in the torque converter and drain it with the installation surface facing up.

s2.ptxt: Clean and Inspect Oil Cooler and Oil Pipe Lines

s3.ptxt: If the torque converter assembly has been inspected or the fluid replaced, clean the oil cooler and pipe lines.

item.ptxt: From the inlet hose 196kPa{2kgf/cm2Clean by blowing in compressed air of }.
If a large amount of fine particles is mixed in the fluid, inject new fluid with a bucket pump or similar and clean again.

s3.ptxt: If the fluid is milky, inspect the oil cooler.

s2.ptxt: Preventing Torque Converter Deformation and Oil Pump Gear Damage

s3.ptxt: If there are interference marks between the tip of a torque converter installation bolt and the bottom of the torque converter installation hole, replace the bolts and torque converter.
All installation bolts must be the same length (difference within 0.5mm) (no spring washers missing).

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Drive Plate & Ring Gear Sub-assembly

s3.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, inspect the drive plate runout.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the drive plate & ring gear.

s3.ptxt: Inspect the ring gear for damage.

atten4.ptxt: If damaged, replace the drive plate & ring gear.
